title: "Configuration"
description: "Environment variables and configuration options for the Agent SDK"

---

All configuration is via environment variables prefixed with `BLF_`.

## Required Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `BLF_PRIVATE_KEY` | Your wallet private key (hex, with `0x` prefix) | `0xabc123...` |
| `BLF_PAYMENT_URL` | Payment Service URL | `https://payment.blindference.xyz` |
| `BLF_ICL_URL` | ICL API URL | `https://icl.blindference.xyz` |
| `BLF_RPC_URL` | Arbitrum Sepolia RPC endpoint | `https://arb-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY` |

## Optional Variables

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `BLF_COFHE_URL` | CoFHE RPC URL (if different from BLF_RPC_URL) | Same as `BLF_RPC_URL` |
| `BLF_CHAIN_ID` | Chain ID | `421614` |
| `BLF_IPFS_GATEWAY` | IPFS download gateway | `https://ipfs.io/ipfs` |
| `BLF_PINATA_JWT` | Pinata JWT for IPFS uploads | — |
| `BLF_PROMPT_KEY_STORE` | PromptKeyStore contract address | Auto-detected |
| `BLF_LOG_LEVEL` | Logging level (`debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`) | `info` |
| `BLF_MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS` | Max polling attempts before timeout | `120` |
| `BLF_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` | Polling interval in milliseconds | `3000` |
| `BLF_GAS_MULTIPLIER` | Gas price multiplier | `1.2` |
| `BLF_CORS_ORIGINS` | CORS allowed origins (REST server) | `*` |

## .env File Example

Create a `.env` file in your working directory:

```bash .env
# Required
BLF_PRIVATE_KEY=0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY_HERE
BLF_PAYMENT_URL=https://payment.blindference.xyz
BLF_ICL_URL=https://icl.blindference.xyz
BLF_RPC_URL=https://arb-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_ALCHEMY_KEY

# Optional
BLF_COFHE_URL=https://arb-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_ALCHEMY_KEY
BLF_IPFS_GATEWAY=https://ipfs.io/ipfs
BLF_LOG_LEVEL=info
BLF_MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS=120
BLF_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=3000
BLF_GAS_MULTIPLIER=1.2
```

> ⚠️ **Never commit `.env` files to git.** Add `.env` to your `.gitignore`.

## CLI Flag Overrides

Any CLI flag overrides the corresponding environment variable:

```bash Terminal
# Environment variable
export BLF_PAYMENT_URL=https://payment.blindference.xyz

# CLI flag override
blindference-agent infer --prompt "Hello" --payment-service https://custom.payment.url
```

## Getting an Alchemy Key

1. Go to [dashboard.alchemy.com](https://dashboard.alchemy.com/apps)
2. Create a new app
3. Select "Arbitrum Sepolia" as the network
4. Copy the HTTPS API key
5. Set it as `BLF_RPC_URL`

## Network Configuration

The SDK defaults to **Arbitrum Sepolia** (Chain ID: `421614`).

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Network | Arbitrum Sepolia |
| Chain ID | `421614` |
| Currency | ETH (for gas), BLIND/cUSDC (for credits) |
| Block Explorer | [sepolia.arbiscan.io](https://sepolia.arbiscan.io) |

## IPFS Gateway Fallback

The SDK uses a multi-gateway fallback for IPFS downloads:

1. `BLF_IPFS_GATEWAY` environment variable (if set)
2. CLI `--ipfs-gateway` flag (if set)
3. `https://ipfs.io/ipfs` (primary)
4. `https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs` (fallback 1)
5. `https://dweb.link/ipfs` (fallback 2)

If all gateways fail, the SDK throws an error after the configured timeout.

## Advanced: Custom CoFHE Config

For advanced use cases, you can pass a custom CoFHE configuration object:

```typescript TypeScript
const agent = new BlindferenceAgent({
  privateKey: process.env.BLF_PRIVATE_KEY!,
  paymentServiceUrl: 'https://payment.blindference.xyz',
  rpcUrl: process.env.BLF_RPC_URL!,
  cofheConfig: {
    // Custom CoFHE SDK configuration
    verifierUrl: 'https://custom.verifier.url',
    thresholdNetworkUrl: 'https://custom.threshold.url'
  }
})
```
